correctness.rationale: The identity h=P/n! is algebraic. The integer-valued Newton-binomial lemma proves each modular shift from exactly 44 tested values of a degree-at-most-43 difference polynomial; 14 complete local enumerations then count every CRT class. The second prefix/suffix evaluator independently checks all local residues, and exact big-integer evaluation checks the CRT witness. For n=35, a 34-point global shift certificate and all 49 residues rule out every order. Known published index exclusions 2..32/even/prime-power complete the ordering. No finite-to-infinite extrapolation or probabilistic independence is assumed.
